Read an uploaded table, honouring the chosen sheet

dot-read_uploaded_table.Rd

Falls back to the first sheet when `sheet` is missing or does not belong to the workbook, so a stale selection left over from a previous upload cannot error out.

Usage

.read_uploaded_table(file_info, sheet = NULL, guess_max = 5000)

Arguments

file_info

One row of a `shiny::fileInput()` value (`name`, `datapath`).

sheet

Sheet name to read. Ignored for csv files.

guess_max

Rows readxl uses to guess column types.

Value

A data.frame.
